evidence: Source review of the explicit-reply removal merged with staging b30f2b25e keeps native build 1 compatible; the minimum remains 1. No HTTP route, request body or response shape changed: send-message, ticket proposal rejection and every conversation route take and return the same fields. The conversation view no longer emits rows or status of kind explicit_reply_missing. The Swift ConversationBody, row and Happened models decode kind as a plain String and have no case for that kind, so its absence changes nothing on device. VIEW_PROJECTION_VERSION stays 4, so cached view cursors stay valid. The removed reply-requirement block was server-to-agent wire text that the app never reads. Staging's own backend changes in this range are the legacy owner-update repair in update_requests.py and update_runner.py, which staging already reviewed as compatible, and server_lifecycle shutdown, process identity and supervisor changes, which serve no HTTP route the app calls. Not checked on a signed device or TestFlight.
